value.name: Asha notices Daniel's evasiveness
value.description: Asha observes Daniel's smile, the removed bank statements, and his refusal to say what he is looking for, while staying silent.
evidence: Asha noted the smile, and the bank statements moved out of her reach, and the fact that he had again declined to name what he was looking for, and she let the hallway hold all three things without remarking on any of them.

value.name: Asha denies searching hidden rooms
value.description: Asha says she has not been in the linen closet or cedar chest and challenges Daniel to explain why he suspects those places.
evidence: Asha did not move toward the stairs. She said she hadn't been in the linen closet or the cedar chest, then asked him, in the same procedural voice she had used about the drawer, why those rooms in particular came to mind.

value.name: Daniel explains his suspicion
value.description: Daniel offers a plausible story that his mother hid things in linens and other unlikely places.
evidence: Daniel held his smile a beat too long before stepping further back from the desk, his hand finally leaving the corner where the bank statements had been, and offered that his mother used to tuck things into linens, sweaters, anywhere except the places a person would think to look.

value.name: Asha recognizes Daniel's prepared excuse
value.description: Asha realizes Daniel had a ready explanation for the linen closet but not for the desk he already searched.
evidence: The answer was almost reasonable, and that was what Asha noted: that he had a story ready for the linen closet but had not had one ready for the desk he'd already overturned.

value.name: Asha approaches the statements
value.description: Asha slowly reaches toward the chair with the rubber-banded bank statements, keeping her expression neutral.
evidence: Asha took one slow step toward the chair where Daniel had set the rubber-banded statements, her hand half-extended, her face arranged into the same neutral she had used for the drawer.

value.name: Daniel blocks Asha's reach
value.description: Daniel shifts to intercept Asha and resumes his smile before she can take the statements.
evidence: Daniel's weight shifted to intercept her, the smile coming back too quickly

value.name: Rosa interrupts the confrontation
value.description: Rosa emerges from the hallway carrying a folded dish towel and clears her throat to speak before Asha and Daniel can continue.
evidence: before either of them spoke, Rosa stepped from the dim end of the hall where the eucalyptus smell was thickest, a folded dish towel still in her hands. She cleared her throat
